synergy.porQueUnEquipo: Why a complete team makes the difference
synergy.enLaOdontologiaTradicional: In traditional dentistry, the dentist takes an impression and sends it to a distant lab that never meets the patient. At Odontogamma Oriente, the master ceramist, the periodontist and the dentist work together in the same clinic.
synergy.estoPermiteEvaluarEl: That means we can check the shade in person under natural light, fine-tune the smile design in real time and perfect every last detail before final cementation.
synergy.elCeramistaParticipaEn: The ceramist joins the shade-matching session under polarized light.
synergy.enciasSanasYSimetricas: Healthy, symmetrical gums before the first veneer is placed.
synergy.armonizacionDeMordidaPara: Bite balancing to prevent fractures and premature wear.
synergy.atencionPrioritariaYAgenda: Priority care and a confidential schedule from start to finish.
